basic_info.description:
Live in the city's hottest neighborhood in one of the only single-family homes on Dolores Park. With an Updated Kitchen, 2 bedrooms and 2 full baths, this beautifully furnished home on Church St. is perfect for hipsters and tech nerds alike. 

No more parking hassles with your own PRIVATE GARAGE. Commuting's a breeze with the tech shuttles and the J Church only steps away. After a day in the park, hang out in your private garden.
Features:

	Two-story, 1,200 square foot house on Dolores Park 
	Remodeled kitchen with STAINLESS STEEL APPLIANCES, quartz counter-tops 
	Sun-drenched living and dining rooms facing the park
	Oversize GARAGE (17' wide), automatic door and cabinets for extra storage 
	Beautiful hardwood floors 
	Washer/dryer, dishwasher, microwave
	Wood-burning fireplace
	Upper Level Bedroom -- large closet plus full bath with jacuzzi tub
	Lower Level Bedroom/Home Office (17' x 11') -- full bath, opens to garden, large closet
	Lush, private garden with patio
	Mounted hi-def plasma; wi-fi/cable/ intercom/home security system all    service-ready 
	Tech Shuttles, J Church, Hipster Hill and Valencia corridor only steps away

Twelve-month lease furnished. Utilities not included. No pets or indoor smokers. 

Open House Sunday May 3, 2015 @ 2:00pm-4:00pm. All are welcome!!
